fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target enemy's location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon arrival, he smashes his hammer to the ground to deal {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies within an area and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds.
fields.description2: ''To the Skies!'' deals {{as|10 '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.
fields.description3: ''{{ai|Lightning Field|Jayce}} can be cast during the dash.''
fields.notes: * ''To The Skies!'' will always direct '''Jayce''' linearly to his target's location.
